First, we simplify the two complex numbers:

$$
\begin{aligned}(\frac{1}{2}+\sqrt{-9})+(3-\sqrt{-16}) & =(\frac{1}{2}+3\,\text{i})+(3-4\,\text{i})\end{aligned}
$$

To add these two complex numbers, we just add the real parts and add the imaginary parts separately:

$$
\begin{aligned}(\frac{1}{2}+3\,\text{i})+(3-4\,\text{i}) & =(\frac{1}{2}+3)+(3+(-4))\,\text{i} \\  & =(\frac{1}{2}+3)+(3-4)\,\text{i} \\  & =\frac{7}{2}-1\,\text{i} \\  & =\frac{7}{2}-\,\text{i}\end{aligned}
$$
